This '''pilot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who, at one point in her life, [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]]. She served as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] pilot for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], during [[Operation Duusha]]. During the operation, she bore an [[Identichip/Legends|identicard]] that matched that of one of the [[Mon Calamari Embassy]]'s employees.
